diff --git a/fastapi/params.py b/fastapi/params.py
index 6a58d580..a836f519 100644
--- a/fastapi/params.py
+++ b/fastapi/params.py
@@ -768,7 +768,23 @@ class Depends:
     use_cache: bool = True
     scope: Union[Literal["function", "request"], None] = None
 
+    def __hash__(self):
+        return hash((self.use_cache, self.scope))
+
 
 @dataclass
 class Security(Depends):
     scopes: Optional[Sequence[str]] = None
+
+    def __hash__(self):
+        return hash((self.use_cache, self.scope, tuple(self.scopes) if self.scopes else None))
+
+    def __eq__(self, other):
+        if not isinstance(other, Security):
+            return False
+        return (
+            self.dependency == other.dependency
+            and self.use_cache == other.use_cache
+            and self.scope == other.scope
+            and self.scopes == other.scopes
+        )
